key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>1%) are nausea, headache and vomiting. In Study 1 (Split-Dose): nausea 2.6% (PREPOPIK) vs 3.7%, headache 1.6% vs 1.7%, vomiting 1.0% vs 3.4%. Warnings include serious fluid and electrolyte abnormalities (which can lead to cardiac arrhythmias or seizures and renal impairment) and rare ischemic colitis.
